function: Neural CSI compression and feedback for FDD massive MIMO, fine-tuning encoder and decoder with entropy-coded model updates sent to the BS (pp. 1, 4).
system: FDD massive MIMO, 64-antenna BS, single-antenna UE, 64 OFDM subcarriers, no RIS; 28 GHz (DeepMIMO O1, CDL), 3.7 GHz (QuaDRiGa), 3.5 GHz (O2 Dynamic) (pp. 7-9).
method: CNN autoencoder with learned entropy coder, trained unsupervised on a rate-distortion loss, then fully fine-tuned at the UE with spike-and-slab prior and update-rate regularizer (pp. 3-6).
data_channel: Pretrained on DeepMIMO O1 ray tracing (28 GHz, 11,920 samples); fine-tuned and tested on QuaDRiGa (Madrid grid), 3GPP CDL-B (TR 38.901), DeepMIMO O2 Dynamic (pp. 7-9).
test_conditions: Trained on DeepMIMO O1 (40/40/20 split); tested on unseen QuaDRiGa, CDL, DeepMIMO O2, without and after fine-tuning on 100 target CSI samples (pp. 7, 8, 10).
baselines: Pretrained (no tuning), encoder-only, translation module TM [20], LoRA, top-k sparsification, FM1, FM1-UP, FM-2bit, genie-aided; no classical CSI feedback baseline (pp. 9-10).
metrics: NMSE (dB), rate in bits per CSI entry (latent plus amortized update rate), SGCS, worst-case and 95th percentile NMSE, deep-outage probability (pp. 7, 11, 15).
complexity: Reports 0.48 GFLOPs per CSI sample forward pass, 1.43 GFLOPs per sample per fine-tuning iteration, about 14.25 TFLOPs total fine-tuning; latency and energy estimated analytically (pp. 15-16).
openness: none; no code or data link given, public DeepMIMO scenarios are used (p. 7).
q1_support: p. 8: "dataset based on the 3GPP CDL channel model defined in TR 38.901"; p. 7: "we employ the DeepMIMO dataset, which constructs MIMO channel realizations using ray-tracing simulations"; QuaDRiGa also used (p. 8).
q2_support: p. 8: "The model is tested on the aforementioned datasets without any fine-tuning."; p. 10: "fine-tuning is performed using 100 CSI samples from the target domain".
q3_support: p. 10: "TM: corresponds to the translation-module-based scheme proposed in [20]" is an earlier learned baseline, but no non-learned CSI compressor is evaluated: p. 1 "compressed sensing [2], [3], vector quantization [4]" appear only in the introduction; p. 10: "Top-k sparsification [42]: a pruning-based baseline in which the decoder is first fine-tuned" prunes a neural update.
q4_support: p. 16: "requires approximately 0.48 GFLOPs per CSI sample"; p. 16: "FLOPstotal ≈ 1.43 × NT × E ≈ 14.25 TFLOPs".
q5_support: p. 7: "the neural CSI compressor is trained using the static outdoor scenario referred to as O1" (public DeepMIMO); p. 8: "DeepMIMO [33] (under a different scenario)". No code or data link of its own.
notes: Page 1 shows the title and the citation line with DOI 10.1109/TMLCN.2026.3742233 (accepted author version; the line 10.1109/TMLCN.2022.1234567 is a template placeholder). Area 2: CSI compression and feedback, BS has 64 antennas so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply. q3 is 0 because every compared scheme is neural (EO, FM variants, GA, Pretrained are variants of the proposed method; TM [20], LoRA and top-k are the external ones) and no classical CSI feedback scheme is evaluated; top-k is post-hoc pruning of a fine-tuned neural update, so the reviewer may reconsider. q5 is 1 only through the public DeepMIMO scenarios, with no released code. Complexity is analytical FLOPs, no parameter count.
